methods.name: listOffers
methods.summary: What can be rented, with price and where it can be created now. Cheapest first.

methods.name: createServer
methods.summary: Asks the provider for a server and returns at once, usually `pending` (waitUntilRunning waits). Throws CapacityError when this offer or region has no stock right now. An option the provider cannot honor is refused (NotSupportedError) before anything is rented, never dropped.

methods.name: getServer
methods.summary: null when the provider has no such server.

methods.name: listServers
methods.summary: The account's servers, every one of them (other people's included): pick yours by name.

methods.name: deleteServer
methods.summary: Idempotent: deleting a server that is already gone succeeds. A provider whose delete waits (Scaleway deletes the server's volumes as they come free) waits for at most `o.timeoutMs`.

methods.name: waitForServer
methods.summary: Poll getServer until `done` accepts what it read (a server, or null once it is gone).

methods.name: waitUntilRunning
methods.summary: Until the server is running (a VM also needs its public address); throws when it errors or disappears instead.

methods.name: deleteServerAndWait
methods.summary: Delete, and keep asking until the provider says it is gone: true only when verified.

methods.name: getServerCost
methods.summary: What the server's current run has cost so far, from its rate and billing start; null when the provider reports neither.

methods.name: stopServer
methods.summary: Stops the server and returns once it is stopped (at once when it already is). Throws when it is gone, or errors or is deleted instead of stopping.

methods.name: startServer
methods.summary: Starts a stopped server and returns once it is running (at once, and with nothing asked of the platform, when it already is); a VM's public address is waitUntilRunning's to wait for. Throws CapacityError when there is no stock for it to come back to: it is then left stopped.

methods.name: restartServer
methods.summary: Reboots a server that runs, and returns once it runs again, for at most `o.timeoutMs` (wait options as IPower's). It is back once it was seen not to run and runs again; one whose status never shows the reboot is taken to be back after reading as running a few times in a row (BaseProvider.RESTART_SETTLE_READS: thirty seconds at the default pace), which is how long a platform is given to show it. A status can lag a reboot by longer than that: where it matters that the machine has really booted again, ask the machine (its boot id over SSH, a mark in its log). A server that is stopped is refused (start it); one that is gone, errors, stops or is deleted instead of coming back is thrown.

methods.name: addSSHKey
methods.summary: Register a public key with the account, or return the account's existing registration of the same key (matched by fingerprint, whatever its name): safe to call on every run.

methods.name: deleteSSHKey
methods.summary: true when the key was deleted, false when the account did not hold it (already gone).

methods.name: listImages
methods.summary: The account's own images (snapshots, captured disks), every one of them: the account may hold images that are not yours to boot or delete, so pick yours by name.

methods.name: getImage
methods.summary: null when the provider has no such image.

methods.name: createImage
methods.summary: Capture a server's disk as a bootable image, and wait until it is available (minutes for tens of GB). The server keeps its state: stop it first when the image must be consistent. With `capabilities.images.scope` 'region' the image boots only in the server's region (until IImageCopy adds more).

methods.name: deleteImage
methods.summary: Idempotent: deleting an image that is already gone succeeds.

methods.name: copyImage
methods.summary: Copies the image to every region it is not in yet, and waits until it is in all of them.

methods.name: importImage
methods.summary: The image made from the file at `url`, in `region`, once it can boot a server (minutes to an hour: the platform fetches and converts it; default wait 1 h). A file the platform cannot read is an error, and so is a wait that runs out: either way the import is deleted, and nothing is left billing.

methods.name: listVolumes
methods.summary: The account's volumes, every one of them: the account may hold volumes that are not yours to mount or delete, so pick yours by name.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.summary: null when the provider has no such volume.

methods.name: createVolume
methods.summary: An empty volume in `region`, once it can be mounted. It bills until deleteVolume, mounted or not.

methods.name: deleteVolume
methods.summary: Deletes the volume and its data, and waits until it is gone where the platform deletes it in the background (a shared filesystem: `o`). Idempotent: deleting a volume that is already gone succeeds. One a server still holds is refused: delete the server first.

methods.name: attachVolume
methods.summary: Attaches the volume, which must be in the server's region and, where it is a block device, held by no other server; waits until it is attached. Attaching a volume the server holds already succeeds. Like a volume it was created with, it outlives the server: deleteServer leaves it.

methods.name: detachVolume
methods.summary: Detaches it, and waits until it is free. Idempotent: a volume the server does not hold is left as it is.

api.name: ApiClient
api.summary: One platform's REST API: its base URL and key, called with http()'s retry rules. A call takes a path, never a URL, so the key only ever goes to the API's own host. Each platform's client (DigitalOceanApi, RunPodApi, ...) extends it with how it authenticates (authHeaders), what counts as a success (succeeded), how its failures read as asap-vps's typed errors (toError), and its raw endpoints.
